mods.description: Unofficial fork of WF's Cave Overhaul

releases.notes:
- Fixed caves generating incorrectly when playing with mods or data packs that add other dimensions alongside the Overworld. Previously, switching between dimensions during world generation could cause Overworld caves to come out shallower than intended or with broken terrain warping.
- Fixed a crash that could happen if a data pack tried to use Cave Overhaul's cave or canyon generators in the Nether, the End, or a custom dimension. The mod's carvers are designed for the Overworld only, and will now safely do nothing in other dimensions instead of crashing your world.

## What's Changed
* Dev 26.1.x by @ndellagrotte in https://github.com/ndellagrotte/cave-overhaul/pull/14


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ndellagrotte/cave-overhaul/compare/v1.19+mc26.1.x...v1.19.1+mc26.1.x

releases.notes:
## warning: new chunks WILL have different cave gen and it WILL make your world look kinda weird

### Commit 3c84e69
- Fixed an issue where noise caves could end abruptly in tall vertical walls instead of tapering off naturally.
- Slightly more noise caves generate in areas that previously had none.

### Commit 7eb304c
- Fixed an issue where caves from the old-world carver could terminate in flat stone walls aligned to chunk boundaries.
- Cave shape and density in old-world carver regions will shift slightly as a side effect — tunnels now cluster a bit more tightly within their home area.

### Commit 6d50344
- Fixed an issue where all cave layers shared a single structural noise pattern, causing layers (especially the duplicated ones below y=-64) to look the same as each other.
- Each cave layer now generates with its own independent structural shape for more variety between depths.

### Commit 385c50a
- Unified how caves and underground rivers apply their large-scale terrain warping, so they pull from a single consistent pattern instead of independent ones.
- As a result, noise caves WILL generate differently from previous versions, especially at greater depths. Existing worlds will show a visible seam between old and newly-generated chunks.

## What's Changed
* Dev (cave-overhaul-v1.19+mc26.1.x) by @ndellagrotte in https://github.com/ndellagrotte/cave-overhaul/pull/13


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ndellagrotte/cave-overhaul/compare/v1.18+mc26.1.x...v1.19+mc26.1.x
